verdict.rationale: Khoj documents a WhatsApp messaging surface, so inbound-message gating is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence shows no sender allowlists, DM policies, or mention gating. The only access-control evidence is Magic Link or Google OAuth authentication for the server, which is an adjacent control and not gating of inbound messages.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, inbound messages are gated — sender allowlists, DM policies, mention gating — so only people I approve can drive my assistant
